QuestInfo.name: [Carcion] A Message from Across the Continent
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart explained that while you were in Carcion, he contacted #bCarlisle#k in Cernium. The line is still up, so talk with Carlisle and see what you can find out.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart explained that while you were in Carcion, he contacted #bCarlisle#k in Cernium. The line is still up, so talk with Carlisle and see what you can find out.
QuestInfo.2:
Carlisle gave you information on the High Flora Army's movements. He also mentioned that #bSeren#k was looking for you... 
The Alliance pledged to protect the ancient gods' power from Darmoor, while seeking clues on how to restore the power of Empress Cygnus.
